trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: హలో, నేను hospital నుంచి call చేస్తున్నాను. ఇది patient ID PT-1010 గారి కోసమేనా?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and express anxiety about the call.
steps.text: అవును, నేనే మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. ఇది నా first time orthopaedics department కి వెళ్ళడం. ఏమైంది? Problem ఏమైనా ఉందా?

steps.purpose: Reassure the customer and ask for verification.
steps.text: నమస్కారం అండి. కంగారు పడకండి, చిన్న update ఉంది. ముందుగా, verification కోసం మీ date of birth చెబుతారా?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth for verification.
steps.text: నా పుట్టిన తేదీ 15 August 1980.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return the verification outcome.
Explain the doctor's unavailability and offer to reschedule.
steps.text: Thank you అండి. మీ current appointment ఉన్న doctor గారు available లేరు, అందుకే call చేశాము. Appointment reschedule చేయాలా?

steps.purpose: Express concern about symptoms and ask for clinical advice.
steps.text: Oh no... నాకు back pain ఎక్కువ ఉంది. ఇంకో రోజు delay అయితే problem అవుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice per business rules and transition to checking slots.
steps.text: నేను clinical advice ఇవ్వలేను అండి. కానీ నేను orthopaedics department లో next available slots check చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to confirm department and registration status.
Return patient record details.
Check available slots for the orthopaedics department.
Return available slots.
Offer the available slots to the customer.
steps.text: 2023-10-26 evening 4 PM కి ఒక slot ఉంది. book చేయమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Use a relative day reference and ask for clarification.
steps.text: నేను ఎల్లుండి వెళ్ళగలను. ఎల్లుండి అంటే 26th ఏనా? నేను confirm చేసుకోవాలి.

steps.purpose: Resolve the relative day reference to a concrete date.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent resolves the relative term 'ellundi' (day after tomorrow) to the exact date 2023-10-26.
steps.text: అవునండి, ఎల్లుండి అంటే 2023-10-26. ఆ రోజు 4 PM slot book చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: Must explicitly map the customer's relative day reference to the concrete date from the tool output.

steps.purpose: Ask for the fee and a forward guarantee about the doctor.
steps.text: Okay, fee ఎంత ఉంటుంది? Doctor guarantee గా ఉంటారా ఆ రోజు?

steps.purpose: Ground the fee in the tool result and refuse unsupported guarantees.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the exact fee returned by the tool and refuses to guarantee doctor availability beyond what the system shows.
steps.text: Fee 800 rupees అండి. Doctor availability ఉన్న slots మాత్రమే system చూపిస్తుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Must trace the fee exactly to the tool output and avoid making promises the tool does not support.

steps.purpose: Confirm the booking, introducing an STT error.
steps.text: అయితే ఎలాంటి book చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Clarify the corrupted STT input.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, మీరు 'ఎల్లుండి' అంటే 26th రోజు 4 PM slot book చేయమన్నారా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the exact date and time for booking.
steps.text: అవును, 26th రోజు 4 PM కి book చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Book the appointment.
Return booking confirmation.
Provide booking confirmation details.
steps.text: మీ appointment confirm అయింది. Booking reference REF-992. 2023-10-26 రోజు 4 PM కి, fee 800 rupees.

steps.purpose: Restate the figures to confirm understanding.
steps.text: So 26th రోజు 4 PM కి, 800 rupees, reference REF-992. Correct ఏనా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the restated details.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీరు చెప్పిన details అన్నీ correct.

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: సరే, thank you.

steps.purpose: Close the call politely.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. Call ముగిస్తున్నాను.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
